race.comment: FLASHY ICON (5) missed narrowly two back before finishing 3.4L off the winner on the Acton most recently. Back onto the turf today, but getting out in trip suits having placed 2/3. Ellison's claim means he'll carry no weight and he can make his presence felt. HARDAZHELL (6) dropped back in trip last time out and flew over the top to score in impressive fashion. Drawn better today and Boudvillain hops on board. Can repeat the dose without surprising. UNMATCHED (8) can get back to his best. DEVINE OUTCAST (2) raced on Sunday at Goulburn and is on the quick turnaround here. Steps out over further which is a big tick and she won't be far away.
